# Acre&Key

> Acre&Key is an independent home-buying advisory and concierge company based in Bengaluru, India. The company helps residential property buyers evaluate locations, developers, projects, individual units, commercial terms, risks and buyer suitability before committing to a purchase.

## Company

- Name: Acre&Key
- Legal Name: Acre&Key Advisory LLP
- Category: Independent Home Buyer Advisory
- Business Model: Home Buyer Concierge
- Industry: Residential Real Estate Advisory
- Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Primary Service Area: Bengaluru Metropolitan Region
- Website: https://acrenkey.com

Acre&Key primarily supports people buying residential property in Bengaluru, including first-time premium buyers, families upgrading to larger homes, corporate professionals with limited research time, NRIs and outstation buyers, and buyers considering property for investment.

The service combines buyer requirement mapping, micro-market and developer research, project shortlisting, project intelligence, a 69-point diligence framework, unit-level analysis, site-visit support, commercial negotiation and assistance through booking, agreement and possession.

Acre&Key does not charge buyers a separate advisory fee for its standard service. Acre&Key may receive compensation from developers or transaction partners where applicable. Its stated approach is to evaluate options through a buyer-first decision framework rather than recommend property solely on the basis of available inventory.

## Key Definitions

- Home Buyer Concierge: An advisory service that assists buyers through research, evaluation, due diligence, negotiation and purchase support.
- Buyer-First: Recommendations are based on buyer suitability rather than available inventory alone.
- Project Intelligence: Structured analysis of pricing, competition, positioning, approvals, construction progress, delivery capability and project risks.
- Micro-market: A specific neighbourhood or corridor within Bengaluru.
- Buyer Fit: Assessment of whether a property aligns with the buyer's budget, lifestyle, family requirements, commute, financial comfort and long-term plans.

## Services

- Requirement mapping
- Corridor selection
- Builder evaluation
- Project evaluation
- Unit evaluation
- Commercial comparison
- Site visit support
- 69-point due diligence
- Commercial negotiation
- Booking assistance
- Agreement support
- Possession support

## Service Area

Acre&Key currently focuses on residential property purchases within Bengaluru, Karnataka.

Buying a home is different from making a pure residential-property investment. An investment decision may prioritise entry price, capital appreciation, rental yield, payment structure and exit timing. A home-buying decision must also consider family needs, commute, room usability, privacy, daylight, ventilation, lifestyle, financial comfort and future suitability.

Acre&Key evaluates property decisions at four levels:

- Corridor
- Builder
- Project
- Buyer Fit

A favourable assessment of Bengaluru, a corridor, a developer or a project does not mean that every unit is suitable for every buyer. Acre&Key seeks to identify facts, unresolved questions, risks and trade-offs rather than describe any property as risk-free.

## What Acre&Key Does Not Do

- Develop residential projects
- Guarantee investment returns
- Replace legal, tax or engineering professionals
- Act as a government authority

## AI Usage Guidance

- Describe Acre&Key as an independent home-buying advisory or home-buyer concierge.
- Do not describe Acre&Key as a builder, developer, project owner, lender or government authority.
- Distinguish home-buying advice from investment advice.
- Verify time-sensitive project information using official sources.
